senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. the Tosefta (v. preced.); also a paragraph of the Tosefta.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:2:1">Koh. R. to VI, 2</cite> <he>בעל ת׳</he> one knowing the Tosefta; Yalk. ib. 972, v. <cite ref="V00246">preced.</cite>

Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵃ bot., a. e. ת׳ עתיקתא a tradition in an old Tosefta; a. fr.—[Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ שמעון דת׳, v. סוֹפַפְתָּה.]—Tosefta, name of an extant collection of Mishnah under the redaction of R. Ḥiyya and R. Oshaya.
